templates.html:
<form class="reset-demo">
  <button type="reset" class="btn-reset btn-reset--{{variant}}" style="--bg:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
</form>
<style>
.reset-demo { display: inline-block; }
.btn-reset {
  font: 600 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif;
  padding: 11px 20px;
  border: 2px solid var(--bg);
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--bg);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.btn-reset--ghost { border-color: transparent; }
.btn-reset:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(36,20,48,.08); }
.btn-reset:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
.btn-reset:disabled { opacity: .45; cursor: not-allowed; }
</style>
templates.tailwind:
<form class="inline-block">
  <button type="reset" class="px-5 py-2.75 text-sm font-semibold bg-transparent cursor-pointer disabled:opacity-45 disabled:cursor-not-allowed hover:bg-black/5 btn-reset-tw btn-reset-tw--{{variant}}" style="border:2px solid {{bg}};color:{{bg}};border-radius:{{radius}}px"{{#if disabled}} disabled{{/if}}>{{label}}</button>
</form>
<style>
.btn-reset-tw--ghost { border-color: transparent !important; }
.btn-reset-tw--{{variant}}:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #241430;outline-offset:2px; }
</style>
